general_pin_hint: The floating player stays visible over other windows.
autostart_hint: Opens MiniPlayer for Browser Music when you sign in to Windows.
general_mode_hint: Floating: a small window you can place and resize. Taskbar: compact, next to the clock.
taskbar_only_hint: These options apply when the player is on the taskbar (General → Where to show the player).
history_view_hint: Songs you listened to, by day, and statistics. Also from the tray or the player right-click menu.
general_pin: Keep the player on top of other windows
general_snap: Where the player snaps when dragged
general_snap_hint: Near an edge, the player sticks to it. "Screen edges" lets it sit over the taskbar, flush with the bottom.
lyrics_hint: In the floating player they appear below; on the taskbar, in place of the artist. Sends title and artist to lrclib.net.
sleep_hint: Pauses the music after the chosen time. Also in the player's right-click menu and in the tray.
sleep_fade: Fade the volume out before pausing
themes_hint: Themes are .json files in the themes folder (see exemplo-oceano.json). Saving the file updates it instantly.
hdcover_hint: Browsers hand over a small cover (about 120 px). Looks up the 1000 px album cover on Deezer or, for videos, the 1280 px YouTube thumbnail, by title and artist.
viz_hint: Bars that pulse with the playing tab's sound: in the player (at the position below) and beside the title on the taskbar.
viz_pos_bottom: Strip along the bottom of the player
viz_bars_hint: All the way left = automatic (fits the space).
zoom_hint: Also: Ctrl + mouse wheel over the player. Drag the edges to change the shape (mini, normal, portrait).
hotkeys_hint: Work from any window. Click the field and press the combination (with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win). Backspace removes it.
wheel_player: Mouse wheel on the floating player
wheel_hint: Change track: scroll up = previous, down = next. Ctrl + wheel always changes the player zoom.
calls_enable: Pause the music while the microphone is in use
calls_hint: Detects calls and meetings in any app (Teams, Meet, Discord, Zoom, WhatsApp…) through microphone use.
calls_apps: Apps that count as a call
calls_apps_hint: Apps that have used the microphone. Uncheck the ones that aren't calls (e.g. recorders, audio drivers).
duck_enable: Lower the music when another app plays sound
duck_hint: Videos, notifications, voice messages… The music comes back 1.5 s after the other sound ends. Tabs of the music's own browser count as the music.
history_record: Record the songs I listen to
history_record_hint: Stays on this computer only (%APPDATA%\MiniPlayer\history.jsonl). A song is added after 30 s of listening.
np_hint: To show the song in your stream or recording (OBS, Streamlabs…). The files update by themselves on every change.
np_clear_paused: Leave empty while the music is paused
np_howto_text:
• Text: add a "Text" source, check "Read from file" and pick nowplaying.txt (or title.txt / artist.txt).
• Cover: "Image" source with cover.png.
• Ready-made card: "Browser" source, check "Local file" and pick overlay.html (transparent background; suggested size 800×300). Change its look with "Edit overlay…".
taskbar_screen_hint: With more than one monitor, turn on "Show my taskbar on all displays" in Windows.
taskbar_autohide_hint: Disappears after 3 s without media or 30 s paused; comes back when something plays.
taskbar_position_hint: Drag the title on the taskbar to move the player sideways.
taskbar_reset_position: Move back next to the clock
updates_store: This copy came from the Microsoft Store, which installs new versions automatically.
updates_keep_hint: On launch, installs the new version by itself. While running, downloads in the background and installs on the next launch (without interrupting the music).
updates_not_installed: This copy wasn't installed with the installer, so it doesn't update itself. Use MiniPlayer-win-Setup.exe.
about_desc: Shows and controls the music playing in your browser (YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Deezer…) using Windows media controls.
releases_link: See what's new in each version on GitHub
history_empty:
Nothing in the history yet.
Songs show up here after 30 s of listening.
tip_taskbar_dblclick: Double-click to go back to normal mode
toast_new_title: MiniPlayer for Browser Music: new version
toast_downloaded_title: MiniPlayer for Browser Music: update downloaded
toast_downloaded_text: Version {0} will be installed the next time the app opens.
sleep_end_of_track: At the end of this song
theme_show_author: Show the theme author in the player
backup_hint: A .zip file with the settings and custom themes. Handy to move to another PC.
backup_confirm: Importing replaces all current settings (and themes with the same name). MiniPlayer will restart. Continue?
backup_invalid: the file is not a MiniPlayer backup
history_clear_confirm: Delete the {0} songs from the history? This can't be undone.
other_tab_playing: ▶ Another {0} tab is playing — press pause/play on it to control it here
sessions_one_per_browser: Each browser exposes only one media tab at a time (the active one). To pick another tab, press play on it.
hotkey_taken_tip: Another program already uses this combination. Pick another one.
mic_none: No app has used the microphone yet.
ov_row_hint: Choose what shows, the order, colors, sizes and animation, with a live preview.
ov_preview_hint: This is the real overlay.html page. In OBS it updates by itself, without flicker.
ov_marquee: Long titles scroll instead of being cut
err_unexpected:
Something went wrong (details in error.log in the data folder).

err_media:

balloon_new_text: Version {0} ready to install. Click here to update.

update_latest: You're already on the latest version ({0}).
editor_preview_hint: The preview updates as you edit. The theme is saved to the themes folder as .json.
editor_author_position: Where to show the author in the player
